{{Quote|Nothing can stop the Gungan Sling Brigade!|The slingshot announcer|<ref name="ELAC" />}}
The '''Gungan Sling Brigade''' was a quartet of [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] performance artists who practiced [[Gungan sling painting|sling painting]]. Each of them wore an outfit and a mask the hue of which matched one of the four primary [[Color/Legends|colors]] and were nicknamed accordingly: [[Red (Gungan)|Red]], [[Yellow (Gungan)|Yellow]], [[Blue (Gungan)|Blue]] and [[Green (Gungan)|Green]]. With their slings, they would throw paint "balls" of undefined nature&mdash;which were in fact natural and grown in the underwater [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Otoh Gunga/Legends|Otoh Gunga]].<ref name="ELAC" />

The members of the Sling Brigade had a reputation for never missing their shot, and they enjoyed great popularity amongst the citizens of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]], [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Naboo (people)/Legends|colonists]] of Naboo.<ref name="ELAC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Gungan Sling Brigade first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: Early Learning Activity Center]]'', an educational ''Star Wars'' [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released in [[2000]] by [[Lucas Learning]].<ref name="ELAC" />
